reconstruction_status: Explicit reconstruction from archived dataset-level characteristics
random_seed_status: New reconstruction seed; not the historical generator seed
network_context: Ethereum Sepolia was used for prototype deployment and demonstration transactions; the 300-record performance dataset is synthetic controlled simulation data
confirmation_model: One simulated confirmation; not a live Sepolia confirmation measurement

latency_generation.distribution_status: Explicit reconstruction choice; original historical distribution not retained
latency_generation.sampling_method: 50 base normal draws per scenario, then affine transformation to the predefined target mean and target sample standard deviation
latency_generation.note: These values define the regenerated simulation model. They are not claimed to be the undocumented parameters of the original historical generator.

response_time_generation.note: The original historical data-generation script was not retained. This parameterization documents the new explicit reconstruction model used to regenerate the response-time values.

vendor_milestone_configuration.note: Assignments are constructed so that exactly 61 of 300 records are direct-transfer-like, matching the archived dataset's workload structure.
